gen-fs-array-gf-lexend-zetta: Futuristic and precise, Array draws open curves with room to breathe. Lexend Zetta, a plain sans with widely tracked letters, glides along on unchanging strokes, so paragraphs skim easily.
gen-fs-array-gf-montserrat-alternates: Montserrat Alternates is a plain sans with round letters crowding toward the capital line, while Array stays precise and futuristic. Paragraphs in it move briskly, with a contemporary, businesslike feel.
gen-fs-bespoke-stencil-clash-grotesk: Clash Grotesk is a plain sans drawn without any stroke modulation, clean and approachable in every line. Bespoke Stencil adds the industrial command that is the real draw here, though it is no choice for long paragraphs.
gen-fs-bespoke-stencil-fs-epilogue: Commanding and industrial, Bespoke Stencil heads the page over Epilogue, a sans-serif with curvy, tall-bodied letters and stubby ascender tips. Longer text moves smoothly on its wire-thin, monoline lines.
gen-fs-bespoke-stencil-fs-supreme: Supreme is a crisp sans with letters held open, never curled shut. Bespoke Stencil is best at commanding, industrial impact; Supreme is better at the thick, heavy-looking strip of running text.
gen-fs-bespoke-stencil-general-sans: General Sans is a plain sans whose x-height fills the line. Bespoke Stencil brings the commanding, industrial punch, and General Sans carries clean running text in smooth, unobstructed curves.
gen-fs-bespoke-stencil-gf-syncopate: Industrial and commanding, Bespoke Stencil takes the lead in a plain, upfront way. Syncopate, a plain sans, follows with open curves and the single-width trail of a rolling-ball pen, steady throughout.
gen-fs-bespoke-stencil-manrope: Bespoke Stencil is plain and commanding, an industrial display face. Manrope, a sans with bright open mouths on its curves and one line width throughout, feels clean and approachable.
gen-fs-bespoke-stencil-switzer: Commanding and industrial, Bespoke Stencil hits hard as a display face with a plain build. But Switzer, a sans-serif with a tall waist line and wire-like, tubular letterforms, does the quieter work of carrying text.
gen-fs-bevellier-fs-bespoke-sans: Bevellier is sophisticated and graceful, with close sidebearings and a high, wide-looking lowercase. Bespoke Sans, a plain sans with generous space where curves meet the stem, feels sharp and refined beside it.
